Lemma
[The reduced distance of a Type I solution has at most quadratic growth in space] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0167, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0168, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0169 1. ch30:30.15\group Singular-Time Reduced Volume

Let a complete bounded-curvature Ricci flow on $[\alpha ,\omega ]$ satisfy $|\Rm |\leq M/(\omega -t)$, and put $\ell =\ell _{p,\omega }$. For every $\varepsilon \in (0,(\omega -\alpha )/2)$ there are $A,B<\infty $, depending only on $n,\varepsilon ,M$, such that \[ \ell (x,t)\leq \frac{B d_{g(t)}(q,x)^2}{2(\omega -t)}+\frac AB+2\ell (q,t) \] for $t\geq \alpha +\varepsilon $. In particular, \[ \ell (x,t)\leq \frac{B d_{g(t)}(p,x)^2}{2(\omega -t)}+\frac AB+2n^2M. \]
